AnalysisDocument.description:
A research computation (Stage 5): a registered method and version, its parameters, and its
named inputs, read only before `until`, and before every run's own cutoff.

project.description: The project the analysis belongs to; its until is capped at the project's confirmation start.

since.description: Leave out of the sample every session before this date; earlier data may still be read for alignment.

until.description: Read nothing on or after this date.

AnalysisDocument.title: AnalysisDocument

BarsInput.description:
A bars dataset's session returns: `percent`, the close's change as a fraction, or
`price_change`, the close's change times the multiplier, in currency per contract.
BarsInput.title: BarsInput

Budget.description: The most a recording may ask and spend (Phase 4B).

max_cost.description: What the whole extraction may cost: its stored responses, plus the upper bound of those missing.

max_requests.description: Distinct requests the whole extraction may make, those already stored included.

Budget.title: Budget

ColumnMapping.description: The CSV header names holding each field.
ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping

ContinuousSeries.description:
How a continuous futures series was built from its contracts (Stage 5 amendment A3). Its prices
are research data, not executable prices: a backtest refuses them.

adjustment.description: difference: earlier contracts shifted by price differences at each roll; none: spliced as traded.

contracts.description: Every contract, in order, covering every session exactly once.

roll_rule.description: When the series moves to the next contract, as the provider states it.

ContinuousSeries.title: ContinuousSeries

ContractSegment.description: One contract a continuous series is built from, and where it is used.

adjustment.description: Added to the contract's own prices in the series (0 for an unadjusted series).

first_session.description: Its first session in the series.

last_session.description: Its last session in the series, before its expiry.

symbol.description: The contract's own symbol, such as its month code and year.

ContractSegment.title: ContractSegment

DatasetManifest.description:
Describes an immutable daily OHLC dataset. Its canonical JSON hash is the dataset ID, so any
change to data or metadata produces a different dataset.

bar.description: One row per trading session, indexed by session date.

import_report.description: Present only on datasets imported from a file.

redistributable.description: Whether exports may include the data bytes.

source.description: Where the data came from, e.g. the synthetic generator and its seed.

DatasetManifest.title: DatasetManifest

Derivation.description:
How a feature dataset was extracted from documents (Phase 4B). Its files, extraction.json,
responses.jsonl and documents.json, sit beside the data and are checked against these hashes
when it is loaded.

cost.description: Of the responses used, at the prices declared when each was recorded.

documents.description: The documents dataset ID: the SHA-256 of documents.json, its manifest, beside the data.

duplicates.description: Document versions dropped as copies of an earlier one's text.

hosted.description: Whether document text was sent to a hosted provider.

invalid_rows.description: Rows with no values, by reason.

reported_models.description: Every model identifier the responses reported.

responses_sha256.description: Of responses.jsonl: each row's document version, publication time and URL, and its stored response, with its rendered request.

retrospective_rows.description: Rows whose response was captured after they could be used.

Derivation.title: Derivation

DocumentColumns.description: The CSV header names holding each document field (Phase 4B).

estimated.description: An optional true/false column marking publication timestamps reconstructed after the fact.

event.description: The date the document is about; by default the UTC date of publication.

id.description: The document's identifier, shared by all its versions.

published.description: When this version was published: ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

revision.description: An optional label for each version, such as 'corrected'.

url.description: Where the document came from: kept as metadata, never fetched.

DocumentColumns.title: DocumentColumns

DocumentsDeclaration.description: What the user declares about a CSV file of documents, such as news or reports, before it is imported.

estimates.description: How the estimated publication timestamps were made; required when any row is estimated.

event_format.description: strptime format of the event column; required when there is one.

evidence_class.description: point_in_time requires every timestamp to be the one recorded at publication.

hosted_processing.description: Whether the text may be sent to a hosted model provider. There is no default: it must be declared.

kind.description: Tells a documents declaration from a bars or observations one.

DocumentsDeclaration.title: DocumentsDeclaration

DocumentsManifest.description:
Describes an immutable documents dataset: one row per version of each document, with the
moment it was published. Its canonical JSON hash is the dataset ID. No operator reads one, so a
strategy never sees raw text; extraction turns it into observations (Phase 4B).

estimates.description: How estimated publication timestamps were made; present only when some are.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the imported file's bytes.

DocumentsManifest.title: DocumentsManifest

EquityInput.description: A succeeded run's backtest equity, as session returns: the change in equity as a fraction.
EquityInput.title: EquityInput

Experiment.description:
A search over the parameters of one strategy revision (Stage 4). Every trial is an ordinary run
of that revision with one point of the search, cut off at the holdout start, so no trial reads
holdout data. A grid tries every point; a random search draws `trials` distinct points with
`seed`. Either way an experiment has at most 200 trials.

exploratory.description: Exploratory analysis, which may read exploratory data (Phase 4B). Its ranking and holdout evaluations are labelled exploratory and never counted as verified. A verified experiment (the default) reading exploratory data is refused.

holdout_start.description: Trials read only the sessions before this date; the holdout is every session from it.

objective.description: The backtest metric trials are ranked by.

seed.description: Random search: the seed, kept with the experiment so its trials can be drawn again.

trials.description: Random search: how many distinct points to draw.

Experiment.title: Experiment

ExperimentInput.description:
A finished experiment: every trial's parameters and status, and the session returns of its
succeeded trials over their common window, as its ranking compares them, best first.
ExperimentInput.title: ExperimentInput

Extraction.description:
How to turn a documents dataset into a feature dataset through a model's structured answers
(Phase 4B). `qrs extract` replays it from stored responses; with --record it first asks the
provider for the missing ones, within the budget.

capture.description: Change it to ask the provider again: the response store is keyed by it.

dedupe.description: Drop later copies of identical text (whitespace aside), keeping the earliest publication.

endpoint.description: A local provider's address, or the fixture's answers file; none for a hosted provider.

latency_seconds.description: Declared processing latency: a row is usable this long after its document at the earliest.

options.description: Decoding settings the provider accepts, sent as given.

prompt.description: Sent for each document version, with {title} and {text} in place: no other placeholder.

redistributable.description: Whether exports may include the features and their responses; also needs the documents to be redistributable.

Extraction.title: Extraction

FamilyBlock.description: A family's hypotheses, evaluations, adjusted p-values and conclusions.
FamilyBlock.title: FamilyBlock

FamilyDocument.description:
Hypotheses registered together as one frozen unit (Stage 5): they are tested together and
their p-values adjusted together. Confirmatory registration is refused if the test period of any
dataset in the project's scope has been read (amendment A2).

correction.description: Holm; Benjamini–Hochberg; or Benjamini–Yekutieli, where dependence may be negative.

FamilyDocument.title: FamilyDocument

Fill.description: One executed order, as listed in a backtest's fills.
Fill.title: Fill

FillsInput.description:
A succeeded run's backtest fills, as one value per session of its equity: the quantity bought
less the quantity sold, or the commission or slippage paid; 0 on sessions without a fill.
FillsInput.title: FillsInput

Hypothesis.description:
One registered hypothesis: its statement and the analysis that tests it, over the test period
from the project's confirmation start (to its `until`, if any). It is supported only when its
adjusted p-value is below the family's level with the estimate in the registered direction.
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

ImportDeclaration.description: What the user declares about a CSV file of daily bars before it is imported.

calendar.description: The venue's exchange calendar, a pandas_market_calendars name such as CBOT_Agriculture; null expects every weekday.

date_format.description: strptime format of the date column, e.g. %Y-%m-%d.

price_unit.description: currency: prices in the instrument's currency; cents: hundredths of it, divided by 100.

ImportDeclaration.title: ImportDeclaration

ImportReport.description: How an imported dataset was read from its file, and the expected sessions the file lacks.

calendar.description: Where the expected sessions came from: an exchange calendar and its library version, or 'weekdays (approximate)'.

missing_sessions.description: Expected sessions between the first and last rows that the file lacks; reported, never filled.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the imported file's bytes.

ImportReport.title: ImportReport

Instrument.description:
One futures contract, or a continuous series of contracts (Stage 5). Prices are quoted in
`currency` per unit of the underlying; one contract's value is price × multiplier.

continuous.description: Present only for a continuous series: how it was built from its contracts.

expiry.description: Last day the contract may be held; data must end before it. None only for a continuous series.

margin_init.description: Initial margin as a fraction of notional value.

margin_maint.description: Maintenance margin as a fraction of notional value.

Instrument.title: Instrument

inputs.description: Each input's name and the input kinds it accepts.

outputs.description: Each table or figure, and whether it holds rows of its inputs or only aggregates.

tests.description: What it tests: a directional estimate, a joint restriction, or nothing.

ModelInput.description:
A term of the models a run's fit node fitted: a feature's coefficient (on the standardised
feature, as fitted) or the intercept, at the session at whose close each model was fitted.

term.description: A feature the model was fitted on, or 'intercept'.

ModelInput.title: ModelInput

id.description: Unique in the strategy; also its variable name in generated Python.

version.description: Operator version; results depend on it.

ObservationColumns.description: The CSV header names holding each observation field (Stage 4).

estimated.description: An optional true/false column marking publication timestamps reconstructed after the fact.

event.description: The date the value is about, such as the month a figure measures.

published.description: When the value was published: ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2024-11-26T16:30:00-05:00.

revision.description: An optional label for each revision, such as 'second estimate'.

ObservationColumns.title: ObservationColumns

ObservationsDeclaration.description: What the user declares about a CSV file of observations before it is imported.

estimates.description: How the estimated publication timestamps were made; required when any row is estimated.

event_format.description: strptime format of the event column, e.g. %Y-%m-%d.

evidence_class.description: point_in_time requires every timestamp to be the one recorded at publication.

kind.description: Tells an observations declaration from a bars one.

values.description: Each value column's header and its unit, e.g. {"rate": "percent"}.

ObservationsDeclaration.title: ObservationsDeclaration

ObservationsInput.description:
An observations column, joined at each close of the `on` bars as the As-of operator joins it:
the latest event published by then, in its latest revision, if no older than max_age_days.

on.description: The bars dataset whose sessions and closes the values are joined at.

ObservationsInput.title: ObservationsInput

ObservationsManifest.description:
Describes an immutable observations dataset: values about event dates, each row with the
moment it was published. Its canonical JSON hash is the dataset ID, as for bars.

derivation.description: How the dataset was extracted from documents; present only on feature datasets.

estimates.description: How estimated publication timestamps were made; present only when some are.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the imported file's bytes; present only on imported datasets.

ObservationsManifest.title: ObservationsManifest

OutputField.description: One number an extraction asks a model for, per document (Phase 4B).

description.description: What the number means, as the model is told it.

name.description: A lower-case identifier: the feature column's name.

OutputField.title: OutputField

ProjectDocument.description:
A research project (Stage 5): a question, the datasets in its scope, and the confirmation
start, from which their sessions are the test period. Analyses in the project read only before
it; only its families' evaluations read from it.

datasets.description: The datasets in scope: every dataset the project's families may evaluate.

ProjectDocument.title: ProjectDocument

RecordInput.description: A column of a table a succeeded run saved with a record node.
RecordInput.title: RecordInput

ReportDocument.description:
A report (Stage 5): a project's findings, generated from stored artefacts, never written by
hand. Building it fixes its evidence at a point in the store's history.
ReportDocument.title: ReportDocument

experiment.description: The experiment this run is a trial of, if any.

predecessor.description: The run this one re-ran, if any.

trial.description: Its trial number in that experiment.

SearchAxis.description: One node parameter of the base strategy, and the values an experiment tries for it.
SearchAxis.title: SearchAxis

StrategyDocument.description:
A versioned strategy graph. Only nodes and edges affect execution; name, layout and template
provenance never reach the generated code, so they cannot change a result.

layout.description: Canvas positions by node ID (editor only).

StrategyDocument.title: StrategyDocument

Template.description:
A versioned starting strategy, stored as qrs/templates/<id>.json. Instantiating it copies the
strategy; parameter bounds come from the operators, so a template never restates them.

conditions.description: The market conditions the strategy is designed for and the assumptions its results rest on.

required_bar.description: The kind of dataset the strategy needs: a dataset manifest's bar.

Template.title: Template

TemplateFixture.description:
Bars to check a template on, stored next to it as <template id>.csv, and the fills they give.
A template that reads features also has documents, <template id>.documents.csv, and the
extraction that turns them into features, replayed from <template id>.responses.jsonl (Phase 4B).
TemplateFixture.title: TemplateFixture

text.description: Plain paragraphs, separated by blank lines; shown as text, never as markup.

TrialInput.description:
A symbolic reference, only in a hypothesis's specification: the equity of an experiment's
trial at `rank` in its ranking, from its holdout evaluation. It is resolved when the hypothesis
is evaluated: the holdout evaluation is queued then, and read as an equity input.
TrialInput.title: TrialInput

ValuesBlock.description: An analysis's result: its values, warnings and assumptions.
ValuesBlock.title: ValuesBlock
